Switch 2’s 40th-Anniversary Console Sells Out Immediately, And Guess What Happened Next
description: Nintendo's new 40th-anniversary Zelda-themed Switch 2 console went on sale on September 8, the same day it was announced, and it sold out immediately. I bet you can guess what happened next. Listings for the $520 limited-edition console popped up on eBay the same day, with sellers hoping to make tidy profits. There are numerous listings on eBay asking for $800 and $850--that's about 50% more than the list price. It appears there is a single seller account offering five different units, so this is very clearly a scalping scenario, and it may run afoul of eBay's own rules. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ymw9UTRu1V0 This kind of thing is pretty normal, as people are known to take advantage of a limited-edition product to make some money on the demand. The Zelda console releases on October 29 as part of Nintendo's celebration of the franchise's 40th anniversary. The console sports a spiffy black-and-gold design, featuring the Triforce design as well. Nintendo is also selling anniversary editions of the Switch 2 Pro controller and a Switch 2 carrying case, both of which also feature the Triforce design. The Pro controller ($100) also sold out. The Switch 2 Zelda system has been described as being a limited-edition, so it remains to be seen if Nintendo will replenish stock soon, or ever. The next Zelda game is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake, which releases on November 6 for Switch 2. The game features a lot of significant changes from the 1998 original, and the internet had some thoughts. title: With No 3D Mario In Sight, Mario’s 40th Is A Bust For Switch 2 Owners
description: Another Nintendo Direct came and went without mention of a new Mario game, ending the franchise's 40th anniversary year not with a bang, but with a resounding "huh?" Despite rumors and murmurs from noted leakers, there was no reveal of a 3D Mario game at the September 2026 Nintendo Direct. In fact, the only mention of Nintendo's mascot was a free update to Mario Kart World, which allows you to play SNES courses already in the Free Roam map in Versus mode. Traditionally, Nintendo consoles have been blessed with a 3D Mario not long after they hit stores. Super Mario 64 was a launch title for the Nintendo 64, and Sunshine, Galaxy, 3D Land, and Odyssey all released within a year of their respective platforms' lifecycles. (Wii U title Super Mario 3D World launched a year and four days after the console, but that's close enough.) https://twitter.com/NintendoAmerica/status/2097696070990016647?s=20 Meanwhile, there hasn't even been a hint of a 3D Mario game for Switch 2. At the very least, Mario fans have been able to enjoy Donkey Kong Bananza, which was developed by the same team that made Super Mario Odyssey--and it certainly has a lot of Odyssey's DNA. Still, the lack of a mainline Mario game puts a damper on a monumental anniversary year for the jump-happy plumber. Yes, Mario hit it big at the box office with The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, but all Switch 2 owners have gotten are ports and a tennis game. And while Nintendo counted the adorable Yoshi and the Mysterious Book as part of the celebration, that game is notably Mario-less. Zelda fans are at least getting a full remake of the beloved Ocarina of Time for that franchise's 40th, and a brand-new 3D Kirby game marks the pink puffball's 35th birthday. Even Metroid fans are eating well now. Mario will surely have his due soon, and video game development is a notoriously long and difficult process. But Nintendo seemed ill-prepared for Mario's 40th birthday, and the fact that a successor to Super Mario Odyssey might not come until a decade after that game's release is a disappointment tantamount to finding that the princess is in another castle.

title: The Duskbloods Was A No-Show At The September Nintendo Direct And Now I’m Worried
description: The Duskbloods, From Software's new game and one of the Switch 2's biggest exclusives, was missing-in-action during the September Nintendo Direct. That normally wouldn't be too shocking, except for the fact The Duskbloods is still slated to release this year. With less than four months to go until the end of the year, the window for The Duskbloods is closing. One might have assumed the next game from the creators of Elden Ring would receive a release date as part of the presentation, as well as perhaps a glimpse at some of the maps and playable characters not featured in a recent The Duskbloods closed network test. The fact it wasn't shown or mentioned at all is more than a little worrying. The closed network test for The Duskbloods in August didn't exactly go as planned, with From Software actually cancelling the first day of sessions due to technical difficulties and server issues. Its problems were later resolved for the playtests' subsequent days, allowing players to jump in and take a stab at The Duskbloods' unique blend of cooperative and competitive soulsborne action. It wouldn't be surprising if, given the network test, From Software realized it needed more time to iron out The Duskbloods online multiplayer kinks. Nintendo could, of course, be waiting to hold a special The Duskbloods Direct in the coming weeks just ahead of the game's launch. It's an approach Nintendo has been fond of more recently, holding dedicated Directs for big games like its Star Fox remake, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, and the upcoming The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. In the case of Star Fox and Ocarina of Time, both games received release dates as part of their dedicated presentations. A similar scenario could definitely play out with The Duskbloods, though it's still odd that the game was a no-show at a presentation dedicated to games coming this winter and early next year. Whether The Duskbloods will release this year, or be pushed into 2027, remains to be seen. Demand, however, is certainly there. A From Software employee recently revealed interest in The Duskbloods playtest surpassed that of Elden Ring Nightreign's. Though we didn't get another look or release date for The Duskbloods, there were some big announcements during the latest Nintendo Direct. Metroid Ravenous, a new 2D entry in the series, is coming early next year. An open-world Kirby game, Kirby and the World Beyond, is slated for Spring 2027.

title: GTA 6 Was Not “Fully Formed” When Trailer 1 Came Out In 2023
description: When Rockstar released GTA 6's first trailer in December 2023, the game looked like it was coming along well, but it wasn't "fully formed" back then. That's according to Rockstar North boss Rob Nelson, who said in an interview that the trailer's song, Tom Petty's "Love is a Long Road" was a "mission statement" for the developers to rally around to get the game finished. "With the first trailer for this game, the Tom Petty song was a real sort of mission statement. You don’t have the game fully formed, you have an idea of what it’s going to be, but you really have to push hard to pull that together and so when this team is able to do that--and it’s definitely made with everything that you’ve got, but it’s the best of everything you’ve got at that point--it’s put together in such a way that it helps be a bit of a guiding light of what it needs to feel like," he told Trois Couleurs. Also in the interview, Nelson spoke about how one of the first things the developers did after deciding that GTA 6 would be set in Vice City AKA Miami was to travel there. "We'll go there. And just feel it, and go out and just drive around. Almost always on our own at very first, just a handful of people, and we’ll take a ton of pictures, and soak as much of it up as we can and see what speaks to us and start to talk about it and share ideas about what we want to incorporate," he said. GTA 6 is set for release on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. According to SensorTower's data, the game has already sold 5 million copies via preorders, generating more than $500 million in revenue. Rockstar is partnered with Sony for GTA 6, and part of that deal includes a GTA 6-themed DualSense controller. It goes on sale September 10 at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET for $85.

title: Romancing SaGa 3 Is The Latest Surprise RPG Remake
description: Square Enix has announced a remake of the 1995 RPG classic, Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United, during the September Nintendo Direct. Billed as a "full 3D remake" by the company, this new version of Romancing SaGa 3 will feature upgraded graphics, fully voiced cutscenes, overhauls to combat and other mechanics, selectable difficulty levels, and several more new features. Set in a world with scheduled despair, the game follows eight protagonists on their quest to find the survivor of a calamity. Each protagonist has their own reason for doing so, but the driving force behind their actions is the Rise of Morastrum, an event that occurs every 300 years and results in all newborn life being destroyed, save for one survivor, the Child of Destiny. Like the original game, players will have the opportunity to meet and recruit over 20 other characters along the way, each with individual stats and abilities. These characters can be further fine-tuned with a Nonastrum, a star of fate that the player assigns, which influences their affinity for techs and spells. The Freeform Scenario System will also see player choices shape the characters they meet, and in battle, these warriors can "glimmer" new techniques, gain evasion skills, and perform powerful United Attacks. Square Enix added that War Mode and the Business minigame will also return, allowing players to command armies or grow a trading empire when they're not busy with the main storyline. Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United will launch for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch consoles on February 16, 2027. The SaGa series was a hit franchise for Square, with the first entry in the sci-fi RPG kicking off in 1989 on the Game Boy. A pioneer in open-world exploration and non-linear storytelling, Romancing SaGa and other entries in the franchise have periodically cropped up over the years, and in 2024, Square Enix released Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven.

title: A New Handheld-Only Switch 2 Game Is Coming From The Silent Hill 2 Remake Devs

A Switch 2 exclusive, the 2.5D horror title comes from Bloober Team, the developer behind the Silent Hill 2 remake and Chronos: The New Dawn. The portable-only title will see players becoming "the mysterious Entity," using touch-screen controls to "manipulate reality," according to the YouTube trailer. The protagonist's name is Holden, and he enters a desolate, fog-filled town where things aren't normal (surprise, surprise). Along with the touch screen, motion controls are also utilized to "realign reality." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zS7-Se04c8w Bloober Team has talked about this Nintendo project in the past, which was previously referred to as Project M. Additionally, the studio noted last year that it wants Switch 2 to become the scariest place in gaming. The Direct helped that cause, too, as Capcom revealed that ports of remakes for Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 are on the way for Switch 2 on October 16. title: Samus Is Returning To 2D In Metroid Ravenous, And She Talks Again
description: Today, during the Nintendo Direct livestream, Nintendo announced Metroid Ravenous, a new 2D adventure coming exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 early next year. The debut trailer introduced a new group of mysterious villains, as well as a look at some of the new locales Samus will be traveling through to hunt then down. We also see hints of a a new mechanic where Samus "feeds" on enemies to gain extra powers, though exactly how Samus is augmented by feeding is still a mystery. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ku-vSTDNsT8 We also see a new suit, with green armor and a glowing energy sword. This suit was later revealed to be called the Metroid Suit, with an Amiibo figure of the suit included in the Collector's Edition of the game. Ravenous marks Samus's return to 2D for the first time since 2021's Metroid Dread. Her most recent adventure, Metroid Prime 4: Beyond, launched in December after nearly a decade in development. The Nintendo Direct also featured the reveal of Kirby and the World Beyond, a new open-world adventure starring the famous pink puffball, as well as new editions of Pikmin 4 and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment. Third-party announcements during the Direct included Persona 6 coming to Nintendo Switch 2, a Switch 2 edition of Final Fantasy VII Crisis Core Reunion, and a port of Monsters Hunter Wilds. Metroid Ravenous launches January 28, 2027, exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2.

title: Nintendo Direct September 2026: All The Biggest Announcements And Games
description: The September Nintendo Direct has wrapped up, and, as in previous years, this broadcast offered a fresh look at everything coming to Switch consoles from Nintendo and its third-party partners. There weren't too many first-party reveals--sorry, 3D Mario fans--but we did get a first look at both a new Kirby adventure and another Metroid 2D game that leans hard into its "eat or be eaten" theme. In case you missed it, you can catch up on all the reveals below. Monster Hunter Wilds https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bA8HYCvG0W8 And we're off! The Direct kicked off with Monster Hunter Wilds for Switch 2. It'll be coming to the console on December 4, 2026. This version will include local co-op, and the big Ascendance expansion is also coming to the Switch 2 edition of the game. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=egHsxXxNXLk&pp=0gcJCf4LAYcqIYzv In case you needed a reminder, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will launch for Switch 2 in April 2027. Preorders for this version open later today. The prequel game, Crisis Core: Final Fantasy Reunion, is also coming to Switch 2 today. Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - Definitive Edition https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1oeWfFW1Fk&pp=0gcJCf4LAYcqIYzv Hyrule Warriors is getting a Switch 2 version, which upgrades the game with improved visuals and a harder difficulty mode. It'll be out on February 25, 2027. Meccha Chameleon https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hnXbU-pIgN8 The best hide-and-seek video game, Meccha Chameleon, launches later today for Switch 2. 2026’s Best Friendslop Game Is Coming To Switch 2 Today Pokemon Pokopia Expansion Pass Part 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_a6VU78MISA The next part of the Pokemon Pokopia Expansion Pass is all about style! It adds new in-game accessories like sunglasses, ribbons, and bow ties. Star Fox Adventures is also being added to the Nintendo Classics library today. Now You Can Play Star Fox Adventures On Switch 2 And Decide If It’s Terrible Or Great Yourself The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt Remastered https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNKo-EH76rY You've played it on PC and several consoles; now get ready to play The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt Remastered on Switch 2! The game's new expansion is also headed to the Nintendo console. Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LPyvhKrwjYE Keeping things focused on swordplay, Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 heads to Switch 2 soon. The gameplay shown off does look quite rough though. Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LHP77mZYuMQ The next chapter in the popular Fire Emblem turn-based RPG series is out next week, and yes, it features a nun with a gun. Onyx: The Dark Grip https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zS7-Se04c8w Bloober Team's new horror game has been revealed, and it looks like this is the rumored Switch-exclusive game from the studio. It has a few interesting ideas, from shifting perspectives to mind-reading powers. Two players trapped in different dimensions must fight side-by-side and solve puzzles together if they want to rescue a lost friend in this co-op game. Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qSttSiBrmi0 Under the sea, down where it's wetter, that's where it's better in this new expansion for Disney Dreamlight Valley. And in case you haven't figured it out yet, this new DLC has a Little Mermaid theme to it. Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IWjpIPYlBho&pp=0gcJCf4LAYcqIYzv One of the best Batman games of all time--don't let the Lego aesthetic discourage you--Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is out on September 18 for Switch 2. Plus, new DLC featuring the Joker and Harley Quinn is also out soon. Ondeh Ondeh: Kaya's Tasty Tale https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iiA4Et4yiWM Well, this looks adorable! Ondeh Ondeh: Kaya's Tasty Tale launches for Switch in 2027, and the trailer has made me very hungry, thanks to its heartwarming world and cuisine inspired by the rich cultures of Southeast Asia. Metroid Ravenous https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EtIZCfCoajE The next Metroid 2D game has been announced, and it launches on January 28, 2027. Metroid Ravenous has an "eat or be eaten" theme to it, and it looks like it'll push Samus Aran to her breaking point. Samus Is Returning To 2D In Metroid Ravenous, And She Talks Again Metroid Ravenous Amiibo These look pretty cool! The Metroid Ravenous Amiibo will be available on the same day as the game. Metroid Ravenous: Special Edition And if you're thinking of preordering, here's what the Metroid Ravenous Special Edition looks like. Cairn https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wqNfImlqR_I Climbing game Cairn was released earlier this year, and a Switch 2 version of it launches in early 2027. A whole bunch of Resident Evil is on the way https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iOBBvmV2Q8A&pp=0gcJCf4LAYcqIYzv Capcom's brilliant Resident 2-4 remakes are launching on October 16 for Switch 2. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0fG2mhBgTH4 The remake of the very first Tomb Raider is now confirmed for a Switch 2 release on February 12, 2027. Nintendo Switch Sports Resort https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FZmCtpTSI4E&pp=0gcJCf4LAYcqIYzv Feeling sporty? Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches for Switch 2 on October 22. Mario Kart World https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8nX7R2DI_tE A whopping 10 classic Mario Kart SNES tracks are coming to Mario Kart World alongside two new Knockout Tour routes in an update later today. Mario Kart World Free Update Is Out Today With All This New Stuff Mega Man Dual Override https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ac-c2InQQtY I still can't believe we're getting a new Mega Man game at long last, and this new trailer showed off some cool gameplay of the new tricks that players will have up their robotic sleeves. It's out in Spring 2027. Eternal Anima https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F8kvR_eJ1jQ Time for a new turn-based RPG, set in a world where people only live for today and have given up on tomorrow. As you'd expect, you see things differently, and you set off on a path that diverges from apathy. Eternal Anima launches on March 4. Danganronpa 2x2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sZbIzlndR88 A new mode is coming to Danganronpa 2x2 on January 14, and it's called Slayhem mode. We love it already. Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Za4-IxvxEs In case you need another fighting game for your Switch collection, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves lands on Switch 2 on October 22. Two of the brawlers from the hit manga and anime series Tokyo Revengers, are also being added to the game roster. Metal Slug: Ultimate Collection https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5YITB8v8WKI Sticking with SNK, a massive Metal Slug collection heads to Switch 2 next year. Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DzGpTjuzelg I played way too much Yu-Gi-Oh! GX on my PSP, so I'm keen to see an updated version on Switch 2. It's time to d-d-d-d-d-duel on February 16. Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wtX1kIvG7-g The 1995 RPG classic, Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United, is getting a remake! This revival of the cult-classic game is being upgraded with 3D graphics, combat overhauls, fully voiced cutscenes, and much more. You won't have to wait too long to play it either, as it launches on February 16, 2027, for PC and consoles. Romancing SaGa 3 Is The Latest Surprise RPG Remake Persona 4: Revival https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pvjTOhXVSKY&pp=0gcJCf4LAYcqIYzv What, you thought the next Persona remake wasn't coming to Switch 2? You thought wrong! Persona 4: Revival is coming to the Nintendo handheld, but a lot later than the PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S versions. You'll have to wait until February 18, 2027, if you want to play it on the handheld. Persona 6 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iAMM22ZeklA And that's not the only Persona game coming to Switch 2! Persona 6 is also confirmed to be coming to it, eventually. It's time for a sizzle reel! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oAY2dza_FDg Nintendo also released a trailer that revealed even more third-party games are on the way to Switch 2. Here's the full list of them from the montage: 007 First Light (2026) Fading Echo (December 17) Far Cry 3: Classic Edition (Spring 2027) Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon Classic Edition (Spring 2027) The Crew Motorfest (October 8) The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother (Early 2027) House Flipper 2 (October 15) Sonic Pico Park (November 12) Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World (September 9) Torneko's Mystery Dungeon: Classic HD () Hela: Of Mice and Magic (December 1) Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream (December 3) Stellar Blade: The Complete Edition (November 5) The Ascent: Ultimate Edition (December 2026) It Takes Two (October 15) Palia (December 2026) Bluey's Happy Snaps (October 15) Hot Wheels Infinite Rush (September 10) Hell is Us (October 8) Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition (November 5) Kirby and the World Beyond https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mL4JXbpllfA Closing off the show was the reveal of a new 3D Kirby game, Kirby and the World Beyond. Players can freely explore an expansive world and put Kirby’s Copy Abilities to creative use in this adventure. It has a Spring 2027 release window, which just so happens to coincide with the 35th anniversary of Kirby. Kirby And The World Beyond Announced, Fully Leans Into Kirby As Elder God
